payload.detail: LOCATIONS CORRECTED 2026-09-27 for main 7f8312f2c. src/components/on-call/service-admin-panel.tsx:66 and 329, service-handbook.tsx:153 and service-governance-panel.tsx:186 call toLocaleDateString("en-AU") with no timeZone. These client components still server-render, where the process runs in UTC, so a timestamp near Perth midnight can render as the prior day on the server and a different day in the browser (hydration mismatch). Unconfirmed. Next action: pass timeZone Australia/Perth as src/components/developer-area/hub/freshness-stamp.tsx already does, or share one date formatter.
